turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling Northwind Financial, my name is Marcus. Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'd like to pay my balance with a different card.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can take the last four digits only.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Let me just read it out, it's five two zero zero eight two eight two eight two eight two eight two one zero.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I only need the last four, but I have what I need.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: And my phone is two zero six five five five zero one six four if the payment fails.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Payment of four hundred dollars went through.
